_note: Generic 'where is the data' map shipped with the repo. Verified live; no company data. words = trigger words (matched against the user's search); on_models = describe_model shows the pointer for these resources.

concepts.pointer: Rent is not a field on Leases. Rent = the RECURRING CHARGES set up for the tenant: charge type Rent Charge (RC) plus subsidy types (Rental Assistance RA, HAP, MS8 ...), which are also rent. Show tenant portion + subsidy portion = total. Query RecurringCharges with filters 'UnitID,in,(ids)' or 'EntityKeyID,in,(tenantIds);EntityType,eq,Tenant' and summary='rent' (breakdown per tenant by charge type). Do not read rent from the ledger (Tenants/{id}/Transactions): that only holds what was posted/paid. Asking/market rent: Units embed CurrentMarketRent.Amount, or the Vacancy report.

Lease audit (compare the lease with what is charged): lease rent = ALL tenant-paid rent charge types PLUS rental-assistance / subsidy charge types (RA, HAP, MS8...), summed per lease/tenant, compared with the rent the lease PDF states. Sources: (1) recurring charges on the tenant/unit: query RecurringCharges filters 'UnitID,in,(ids)' (or EntityKeyID + EntityType,eq,Tenant); summary='rent' already splits tenant portion, subsidy portion and total per tenant; (2) lease dates/IDs from Leases (StartDate, EndDate, TenantID, UnitID); (3) the lease PDFs: find_attachments (lease renewals, tenant history category Lease/Rider/Renewal; the PDF often sits on an EARLIER renewal) then download_file. Ledger rows (Tenants/{id}/Transactions) are posted history, not the audited rent. A rent roll can have two rows per unit (tenant + subsidy): sum per unit; it has no lease dates or IDs.

Leases (UnitID, TenantID, MoveInDate, MoveOutDate). For the last tenant of a unit: query Leases with 'UnitID,in,(ids)', orderby '-MoveOutDate', first_per='UnitID' (one newest lease per unit, ONE call for all units).

Security deposit held: Tenants embed SecurityDepositHeld (amount, per tenant); built-in reports SecurityDeposit / DepositDetail; deposit postings are ledger rows (Tenants/{id}/Transactions, Description 'Security Deposits'). The Deposits resource is bank deposits (often empty), not tenant deposits.

Current balance per tenant: Tenants embed Balance (query Tenants with embeds='Balance'). Delinquency/aged lists: recipes delinquency, aged_receivables. Ledger with running balance: recipe tenant_ledger (newest first).
Move dates live on Leases: MoveInDate, MoveOutDate, ExpectedMoveOutDate, NoticeDate (not on Tenants or Units). Recipes move_ins / move_outs cover a date range.

Vacant = physically vacant: nobody living in the unit today; reserved or held units (prospect reservation, Rent Ready, Const ...) count as vacant and are flagged in status_flag / occupancy_flag. Recipe vacant_units (list) or vacancy_report (days vacant, market rent, same units + UnitID). Units has no IsVacant filter (IsVacant is an embed; the filter is IsVacantAsOf = strict, excludes reserved units).
Work orders / service requests = ServiceManagerIssues (resource) with ServiceManagerIssueWorkOrders for the work-order detail; built-in reports ServiceOrderList and IssueList.

Ledger = Tenants/{id}/Transactions (TransactionDate, TransactionType Charge/Payment/Credit, Description, Amount; only 7 filters). It is the posted/paid history, oldest first by default: pass most_recent_first=true (or summary='ledger') so the newest rows are not cut. Many tenants: do NOT loop; recipes payments_received / charges_by_type, or Charges/Payments with PropertyID and date filters.

field_aliases.Rent: not a field: see search_models('rent') (recurring charges)
field_aliases.IsVacant: IsVacantAsOf (filter); IsVacant is an embed only

filter_quirks.RecurringCharges: Spec lists PropertyID and TenantID as filters but the live API fails on them (HTTP 500). Use UnitID, EntityKeyID (tenant id; add EntityType,eq,Tenant), Unit.PropertyID, ChargeType.Name. A ToDate filter drops open-ended charges (ToDate empty), so never filter ToDate when looking for current rent.
filter_quirks.Transactions: Only AccountID, Amount, Comment, Description, MasterPaymentID, Reference, TransactionDate are filterable. TransactionType is not: use local where='TransactionType,eq,Charge'.
filter_quirks.Units: IsVacant is an embed, not a filter. Use IsVacantAsOf,eq,date (strict) or the recipes.
filter_quirks.HistoryNotes: Nested owner filters (Tenant.TenantID, Unit.UnitID, Owner.OwnerID, Vendor.VendorID, Property.PropertyID, ServiceManagerIssue...) fail on the HistoryNotes collection (HTTP 404 or silently 0 rows). Use the sub-resource Tenants/{id}/HistoryNotes (also Units, Owners, Vendors, Properties, ServiceManagerIssues); query routes single-owner filters there itself. Files: find_attachments.
